rows.en: Would you kindly escort the Valkyrie carrying civilians?
Escort the Valkyrie carrying civilians.
Escort the Macross until transformation begins.
Escort the Macross until transformation begins.
All ships have begun transformation.
All ships have begun transformation.
Escort the Macross until the main gun fires.
Escort the Macross until the main gun fires.
The main gun cannot fire. Some manner of fault appears to have occurred.
rows.notes: Transcript 'shuhou' (method) is surely shuhou 'main gun', as in the other operators' clips.

rows.en: The main gun can't fire. There seems to be some kind of fault.
Would you kindly work with the Destroid unit and recover the supplies?
Work with the Destroid unit to recover the supplies.
Numerous enemy combat units closing at high speed.
rows.notes: Transcript 'kousoku' written as 'restraint'; read as 'high speed', as in the shared clips.

rows.en: Many enemy combat units closing at high speed.
rows.notes: Transcript 'kousoku' written as 'restraint'; read as 'high speed'.

rows.en: Destroid 6th, 8th and 17th Squadrons wiped out. Many other losses as well.
Destroid 6th, 8th and 17th Squadrons wiped out. Many other losses too.
Enemy at 12 o'clock high has begun circling. A reconnaissance plane, I should think.
Enemy at 12 o'clock high has started circling. It's likely a recon plane.
Accompany Cat's Eye and go scout the enemy battleship.
Accompany Cat's Eye and go scout the enemy battleship.
We are infiltrating the enemy ship.
We're infiltrating the enemy ship!
rows.notes: Whisper nospeech flag, but the transcript matches the shared line; kept.

rows.en: Cat's Eye has been captured, it seems. Go aboard the enemy ship and rescue them.
rows.notes: 'them' for the Cat's Eye crew, as in the shared clips.

rows.en: Cat's Eye was captured. Board the enemy ship and rescue them.
Escape from the enemy battleship.
Escape the enemy battleship!
Many enemy pods are dropping in. It appears it will come to close-quarters combat.
Many enemy pods dropping in. It looks like close-quarters combat.
rows.notes: 'hakuhei-sen' written with 'ship'; read as close-quarters combat.

rows.en: The enemy is withdrawing, I see.
The enemy's retreating.
New barrier system, rapid deployment.
New barrier system, rapid deployment.
Would you strike down as many enemies as you can before the barrier is breached?
Hit as many enemies as you can before the barrier breaks.
Barrier generators 4 and 7, power output dropping.
Barrier generators 4 and 7, power output dropping.
Fault in the Macross barrier system.
Fault in the Macross barrier system.
The barrier is going to explode! You, at least, must get away!
rows.notes: omae-tachi dake demo: 'you, at least' (the speaker stays behind).

rows.en: The barrier's going to blow! At least save yourselves!
No enemy forces appear to remain.
No enemy forces left, are there?
Escort the liaison shuttle heading to Earth.
Escort the Earth-bound liaison shuttle.
Lt. Ichijyo, would you proceed directly to point A3102 at once?
rows.notes: Transcript 'Ichijou chuui' (written with 'attention') read as 'Ichijyo chuui' = Lt. Ichijyo, and 'shikyuu' read as 'at once'. The shared MUF operator clips render it 'Attention.'; all five other transcripts also start with 'Ichijou'.

rows.en: Lt. Ichijyo, head straight to point A3102 at once.
rows.notes: As row 605: 'Ichijou chuui' read as Lt. Ichijyo; the shared MUF clips say 'Attention.'

rows.en: The enemy fleet is retreating, I see.
The enemy fleet's retreating.
We would like you to broadcast Lynn Minmay's song to give the Boddole fleet a culture shock.
rows.notes: Name mangled in the transcript; Lynn Minmay as in the other operators' clips.

rows.en: We'd like you to broadcast Lynn Minmay's song to give the Boddole fleet a culture shock.
The decisive battle is at hand, it seems.
Decisive battle at last!
Work with Vrlitwhai's Adoclass fleet and destroy the Boddole fleet.
Work with Vrlitwhai's Adoclass fleet and destroy the Boddole fleet.
rows.notes: 'Buri-tai' written as 'Buri squad'; it is Vrlitwhai (Britai).

rows.en: Rescue the survivors.
Rescue the survivors!
The survivors have been rescued, it would seem.
The survivors have been rescued.
Some of the Zentradi have become a rioting mob. Would you kindly suppress them at once?
Some of the Zentradi have turned into a rioting mob. Suppress them at once!
Protect the Micronizer from the rioting Zentradi.
rows.notes: 'boutou-ka' (opening) read as 'bouto-ka' (turned rioters). Glossary terms.json: maikuroon souchi = 'micronization device'; the shared MUF operator clips say 'Micronizer'. Followed the glossary.

rows.en: Protect the Micronizer from the rioting Zentradi.
rows.notes: 'booto-ka' read as 'bouto-ka'; 'jin' read as Zentradi-jin. Glossary terms.json: maikuroon souchi = 'micronization device'; the shared MUF operator clips say 'Micronizer'. Followed the glossary.

rows.en: The Micronizer has been seized, it seems.
rows.notes: Katakana 'dash' read as dasshu (seize), as in the shared clips. Glossary terms.json: maikuroon souchi = 'micronization device'; the shared MUF operator clips say 'Micronizer'. Followed the glossary.

rows.en: The Micronizer was seized!
rows.notes: Katakana 'dash' read as dasshu (seize). Glossary terms.json: maikuroon souchi = 'micronization device'; the shared MUF operator clips say 'Micronizer'. Followed the glossary.

rows.en: The defense target has been seized, it seems.
The defense target was seized!
A Zentradi force has taken hostages and is demanding a battleship, I see.
A Zentradi force has taken hostages and is demanding one battleship.
Would you work with the Destroid unit and take them down?
Join the Destroid unit and take them down.
The hostages have been rescued.
We've rescued the hostages!
Protect the factory and the reaction engine from the Zentradi force.
Protect the factory and reaction engine from the Zentradi force.
The factory is under attack, I see.
The factory's under attack!
rows.notes: Whisper nospeech flag, but the transcript matches the shared line; kept.

rows.en: Damage to the factory is spreading.
Damage to the factory is spreading.
The factory has been destroyed, it seems.
The factory's destroyed!

uncertain: rows 605-606: read 'Ichijou chuui' as 'Lt. Ichijyo' (Hikaru); the shared MUF operator clips render the same line 'Attention.' One of the two readings is wrong; worth a check of the MUF English.
rows 621-624: used the glossary 'micronization device'; the shared MUF operator clips say 'Micronizer'.
